name: functions
//build: esbuild bundles src into one self-contained lib/index.js. Firebase uploads only this directory on deploy, so anything imported from outside it (shared types later) must be bundled in. firebase-admin and firebase-functions stay external because the runtime installs them from dependencies.

scripts.//emulators: Runs against a demo- project id, which the emulators treat as offline-only: nothing can reach the real Firebase project by mistake.
scripts.emulators: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-customer-service --config ../firebase.json
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-customer-service --config ../firebase.json "vitest run --config test/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.//deploy: Always deploy through this script: it builds first. There is no predeploy hook in firebase.json because hook paths resolve differently on Windows and from different folders.
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && firebase deploy --project dev --config ../firebase.json
